prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, your goals (quick settlement vs. trial), and personal fit. I can help you find strong candidates; first, here’s how to pick one and what to do next.

How to find qualified Chicago car-accident lawyers
- Use reputable directories: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, and local bar referral services.  
- Check peer and client reviews and past verdicts/settlements.  
- Confirm licensing and discipline history on the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC).  
- Look for attorneys with trial experience and a record handling car-accident cases similar to yours (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic injury, wrongful death, uninsured motorist, etc.).

Key factors to look for
- Relevant experience: years handling car-accident personal injury claims and medical-injury knowledge.  
- Trial experience: many insurers only offer fair settlements if they think the lawyer will try the case.  
- Track record: settlements/verdicts in cases like yours (ask for examples).  
- Resources: can they advance costs for experts, medical records, etc.?  
- Communication: who will handle the case day-to-day; response time.  
- Fee structure: most work on contingency (common ranges ~33–40%); confirm who pays court and expert fees if the case is lost.  
- Local presence: familiarity with Cook County courts and local adjusters.

Urgent items
- Illinois statute of limitations for most personal injury claims: generally 2 years from the date of the accident (735 ILCS 5/13‑202). There are exceptions and shorter rules for claims against municipalities — act promptly.  
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, witnesses’ contact info.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? Can you give examples/outcomes?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? How often will I hear from you?  
- What is your fee structure and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- What is your assessment of my case and likely timeline?  
- Do you have client references I can contact?

If you’d like, I can:
- Search and provide a shortlist of well-reviewed Chicago personal injury attorneys/firms based on your neighborhood or ZIP code, or  
- Draft an email/phone script for contacting attorneys and scheduling consultations.

Tell me your ZIP/neighborhood, a brief summary of the accident/injuries, and whether you’ve already spoken to an insurer, and I’ll put together a targeted shortlist.
